newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott secures $500 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott secures $500 mln facility.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said Monday it secured into a $500 million revolving line of credit and term loan facility.
The corporation said it would use the funds for acquisition of hotel properties and senior living communities and for general corporate purposes.

"We intend to use this facility to continue our acquisition program of acquiring upscale and luxury full-service hotels, as well as expand our recently announced diversification into senior living communities," the company said in a statement.
The credit facility is led by Bankers Trust Co, with Wells Fargo Bank, Bank of Nova Scotia and Credit Lyonnais acting as co-agents.
